Chadwick, who was thirty-seven weeks pregnant, died from septic shock after her baby died in the womb.
She and her husband regularly shared videos on TikTok and Instagram, documenting their relationship, faith and food challenges, attracting thousands of followers.
Following her death, her devastated family launched a GoFundMe campaign seeking to raise £10,000 to bring her body back to the UK.
